A merger of the Department of Landscape Architecture (LAR) with the Department of Geoscience (GEO) would join two rather small departments that share expertise in areas of great research and socio-economic importance.
Specifically, our departments address climate change issues and resilience planning, management of geological resources, including protection of drinking water resources, and urban development, such as urban flooding control.
